results.title: Fireperf: Open-source network testing tool for firewalls and routers
results.description: The IPFire project has released fireperf, an open-source measurement tool that opens connections at a fixed rate and reports what the device in the middle did with each one. It is free software aimed at administrators, developers and testers who evaluate firewalls, routers and other systems that keep a state for every connection. What fireperf does iperf3, the widely used bandwidth tester, measures how much data two computers can push between them. results.title: Ahold Delhaize USA ramps up in-store technology modernisation push with NCR Voyix technology
results.description: Ahold Delhaize USA is expanding its work with NCR Voyix as it looks to modernise key in-store capabilities across Point of Sale, self-checkout, pharmacy and fuel operations. The multi-year roll-out is now underway, with new PoS technology now available in 100 stores and additional deployment planned
